e.title_en: A quoting interface that puts one small-commercial risk in front of an entire panel of carriers at once: it states in writing that a single application is rated against a panel and every market answers with accept, refer, or decline, each with its own price, its own reasons, and its own full calculation; that the insurance lives in versioned rulebooks rather than in code so that adding a carrier is a new file; that appetite is a carrier decision rather than a property of the risk class; and its rulebooks are organised one file per carrier under a single policy folder, with an MIT licence.

e.body:
**SmallRisk**（`aaronjerez1/smallrisk`）**是一个**小商业综合责任险**的**报价 **API****——**逐字自述为**「**A small-commercial Businessowners quoting API. One application is rated against a panel of carriers and every market answers — accept, refer or decline, each with its own price, its own reasons, and its own full calculation.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**自打标签的仓库**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一条架构决定：**保单逻辑**住**规则书**里**，**不**住**代码里****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**The insurance lives in versioned rulebooks, not in code. Adding a carrier to the panel is a new YAML file.**」**，**并**逐字说明**规则书位置**（**逐字**：**`Rulebooks/BusinessownersPolicy/`** — **one file per carrier**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是本条**最值得记**的**工程判断**：**⭐ 即**把**「**保险逻辑**」**从**代码**里**搬出来**，**它**就**变**成**可**版本化**、**可**对照**、**可**由**业务方**阅读的**资产**——**⭐ 而**「**加一家**承保人**＝**加一个**文件**」**这条**约束**，**同时**是**对**扩展成本**的**承诺**。

**⭐⭐ ② 承保口味归属承保人，**而**不**是**风险类别**的属性****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**Appetite is a carrier decision, not a property of the class.**」**，**并逐字说明**类别码**目录**只**把**危险**分成 **1 至 5 级**，**不**说明**谁**愿意**承保**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一句**是**保险**与**「**通用评分**」**的**分界线**：**⭐ 即**同一**危险等级**的**同**一个**风险**，**在**不同**承保人**那里**可以**一个**接受**、**一个**转核**、**一个**拒保**——**⭐ 故**任何**把**「**是否**可保**」**简化成**风险**自身**属性**的**设计**，**都**会**在**真实**市场**上**失真**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 「**拒保**」与**「**转核**」**也是**带**理由的输出****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字给出**同一**申请**在**四家**承保人**那里的**结果**（**逐字含**价格 **`$ 2,415.23`**、**`$ 3,138.96`**、**`$ 4,083.10`**、**`$ 6,404.53`**）**，**并**逐字给出**换一个**风险（**屋顶承包商）后的**变化**：**一家**转核**（**逐字**：**Highest hazard grade; refer for survey and terms before binding.**）**、**两家**拒保**（**逐字**：**This class is above Cardinal hazard ceiling and belongs in a surplus lines market.**／**Meridian writes preferred classes only**）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一点**对**RIAA **特别有用**：**⭐ 即**「**拒保理由**」**本身**是**数据**——**它**可以**回流**到**产品**与**渠道**设计**，**而**一个**只有**「**能**／**不能**」**的**引擎**则**丢掉**了**这部分信息**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 最便宜者**不是**固定排名****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**The cheapest carrier is not a fixed ranking — it depends on the shape of the risk.**」**，**并**逐字**举**一例**：**同一**类别**在**标准市场**规则书**里**根本**没有**的**一个**步骤**（**逐字**：**This step does not exist in the standard-market rulebooks at all.**）**，**在**超额与**剩余市场**承保人**的**规则书**里**是**一块 **YAML****（**逐字**：**one block of YAML rather than a branch in the** 代码**）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这**正好**解释**了**为什么**「**一单**多市场**」**要**用**规则书**而**不是**用**一堆 **if**：**⭐ 即**不同**市场**的**算法**形状**本身**就**不同**，**而**规则书**允许**每家**表达**自己的**形状**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程形态与可核查性****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字含**一条**构建徽章**（**指向 **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`**）**，**并逐字**说明**接口**为** `POST /api/submissions`**，**一次**请求**得到**四个**市场**的结果**；**⭐ 许可逐字 **MIT****、**主语言 **C#****、**仓库 **767 KB****。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[illogical]] 覆盖**用 **JSON DSL** 表达与**求值**业务规则**、**[[quote-engine-reference-architecture]] 覆盖**报价引擎**参考架构**、**[[titanium-insurance-core]] 覆盖**核心系统**之一**的产品域****——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**多家**承保人的**口味**与**算法形状**并排**放进**规则书**、**并**让**一次**请求**同时**得到**接受／**转核／**拒保三类**结论**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **把**保险逻辑**放进**版本化**文件**，**而**不**写死**在**代码**；**② **明确**「**可保性**」**属于**承保人**，**不**属于**风险类别**；**③ **把**拒保**与**转核**当作**一等**输出**并**附**理由**；**④ **允许**每家**承保人**有**不同**的**算法形状**（**而不**是**一套**参数**）；**⑤ **用**一次**请求**对比**整个**市场**，**而**不**逐家**重录**；**⑥ **用**测试与 **CI** 守住**规则书**的**变更**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有运行**该 API**（**未编译 **C#、**未调用 **`POST /api/submissions`**、**未取得**任何**报价**）**，**故**不主张**其**价格计算**、**不主张**其**承保规则**的**正确性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **C#** 源码**与**任何**规则书 **YAML** 内容**。**③ ⚠️ README 中**四家**承保人**与**价格**为**作者**给出的**示例**，**⚠️ 本词条**只**如实转述**，**未**核实**其**是否为**真实**市场**或**真实**费率**（**⭐ 本词条**按**示例**理解**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**规则书**的**版本化**是否**真的**接入**了**变更审查**（**⭐ 只见**构建徽章**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**与**任何**承保人**、**经纪**或**监管**要求**相关**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该 API** 是**技术演示**，**不是**可**对外**报价的**系统**，**也**不是**承保意见**。

e.body_en:
This is a quoting interface for small-commercial business owners coverage, stating in writing that one application is rated against a panel of carriers and every market answers with accept, refer, or decline, each with its own price, reasons, and full calculation. **This entry belongs to the round theme of self-tagged repositories.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, an architectural decision is stated up front: the insurance lives in versioned rulebooks rather than in code.** Adding a carrier to the panel is a new file, and the rulebooks sit one file per carrier under a single policy folder. **Moving insurance logic out of code turns it into an asset that can be versioned, diffed, and read by business colleagues, and the constraint that adding a carrier means adding one file is simultaneously a promise about the cost of extension.**

**Second, appetite belongs to the carrier rather than to the risk class.** The description states this in writing and explains that the class-code catalogue grades hazard on a small scale while saying nothing about who will write it. **This sentence marks the boundary between insurance and generic scoring, because the same risk at the same hazard grade can be accepted by one carrier, referred by another, and declined by a third, so any design that reduces insurability to a property of the risk itself will misrepresent a real market.**

**Third, refusal and referral are also reasoned outputs.** The description gives the same submission rated across four carriers with four prices, and then shows what happens when the risk changes to a roofing contractor: one carrier refers with a note that the highest hazard grade needs a survey and terms before binding, one declines because the class exceeds its hazard ceiling and belongs in a surplus lines market, and another declines because it writes preferred classes only. **Refusal reasons are themselves data that can feed back into product and distribution design, whereas an engine that returns only a binary yes or no discards that information.**

**Fourth, the cheapest carrier is not a fixed ranking.** The description states that the cheapest depends on the shape of the risk, and gives the example of a calculation step that does not exist in the standard-market rulebooks at all but appears in the surplus lines carrier rulebook as a single block of configuration rather than a branch in code. **This is why a panel needs rulebooks rather than a pile of conditionals: different markets genuinely have different shapes of algorithm, and rulebooks let each one express its own.**

**Fifth, on engineering form**: the description carries a build badge pointing at a continuous-integration workflow, and names the interface as a single submission endpoint that returns four markets at once, with an MIT licence, a C# codebase, and a repository under a megabyte.

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a JSON rule-expression language, a quote engine reference architecture, and a core-system product domain, **while this entry supplies the form in which several carriers appetites and algorithm shapes sit side by side in rulebooks and one request returns acceptances, referrals, and declines together. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: keep insurance logic in versioned files rather than in code; treat insurability as the carrier decision it is; make refusal and referral first-class outputs with reasons; let each carrier have its own algorithm shape rather than one parameter set; compare a whole market in one request instead of re-keying per carrier; and guard rulebook changes with tests and continuous integration.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the interface was not run**, nothing was compiled and no submission endpoint was called, **so no claim is made about its price calculation or the correctness of its underwriting rules**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the C# source or any rulebook file. **Third, the four carriers and their prices are the author own example, transcribed here without verification that they represent a real market or real rates. Fourth, whether the rulebook versioning is actually wired into change review was not verified**, only a build badge being visible. **Fifth, no relationship to any carrier, broker, or regulatory requirement was verified. Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the interface is a technical demonstration rather than a system that can quote externally, and not an underwriting opinion.**
